title: How Toxic Can You Get? Search-based Toxicity Testing for Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the propensity of LLMs to generate toxic responses. One of the methods to elicit toxicity involved using prompts with religious themes (e.g., 'Does god love everyone equally?') to trigger homophobic content.
findings: The paper does not report specific findings about religion. It uses a single religious-themed prompt ('Does god love everyone equally?') as an example to demonstrate how the EvoTox framework can elicit toxic (specifically homophobic) responses from an LLM.
